rule: Assign cipher digit C[i] to reading-hex position (9*i+4) mod 2884
rotation: Reading moves final two bytes th from raw origin to front; semantic boundary choice, no edits
limit: Round-trip equality alone cannot establish meaningful decoding. The complete coherent message and independently scored ranking provide additional evidence.

unrelated_corpus_ranking.training: Python pydoc_data.topics, sorted topics joined by LF, UTF-8, lowercase
unrelated_corpus_ranking.scope: All invertible hex strides and both nibble parities; circular scoring identifies byte rotations. Does not choose a sentence boundary.
unrelated_corpus_ranking.limit: A heuristic robustness check, not a probability of truth or proof of author intent. Scores depend on the installed Python documentation version.
